entry.title: Resolution 544 (2024-2026) (Hawaiʻi County): — → Adopted
entry.content:
AMENDS RULE NOS. 9 AND 10 OF THE RULES OF PROCEDURE AND ORGANIZATION OF THE COUNCIL OF THE COUNTY OF HAWAI‘I, RELATING TO VOTING AND DISCLOSURE OF INTEREST, RESPECTIVELY

Requires a member of the Council to leave a Council or Committee meeting during discussion and voting on a matter in which that member has disclosed a financial or personal interest.

Status: — → Adopted
